+# Tensor products over algebraic extensions at finite subextensions
+
+Elements and equalities in a tensor product with an algebraic field extension are already
+defined at finite intermediate extensions.  These are finite-field wrappers around the
+finitely generated subalgebra results in `Mathlib.RingTheory.TensorProduct.DirectLimitFG`.

+/-- Every element of `K ⊗[F] B` comes from `L ⊗[F] B` for some finite subextension

+theorem exists_finSubext_tensorProduct_preimage
+    {F K B : Type u} [Field F] [Field K] [Algebra F K] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F K]
+    [CommRing B] [Algebra F B] (x : K ⊗[F] B) :
+    ∃ L : FinSubext F K, ∃ xL : L.1 ⊗[F] B,
+      LinearMap.rTensor B L.1.val.toLinearMap xL = x := by
+  obtain ⟨A, hA, xA, hxA⟩ := TensorProduct.Algebra.exists_of_fg x
+  letI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic F A :=
+    Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_injective A.val Subtype.val_injective
+  let L0 : IntermediateField F K := Algebra.IsAlgebraic.toIntermediateField A
+  letI : Algebra.FiniteType F L0 := by
+    change Algebra.FiniteType F A
+    exact (Subalgebra.fg_iff_finiteType A).mp hA
+  letI : Module.Finite F L0 := Algebra.finite_of_essFiniteType_of_isAlgebraic
+  let L : FinSubext F K := ⟨L0, inferInstance⟩
+  exact ⟨L, xA, hxA⟩
+
+/-- If two tensors over a finite subextension become equal over `K`, they are already equal
+after passage to some larger finite subextension. -/
+theorem exists_finSubext_tensorProduct_eq
+    {F K B : Type u} [Field F] [Field K] [Algebra F K] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F K]
+    [CommRing B] [Algebra F B] (L : FinSubext F K) (x y : L.1 ⊗[F] B)
+    (hxy : LinearMap.rTensor B L.1.val.toLinearMap x =
+      LinearMap.rTensor B L.1.val.toLinearMap y) :
+    ∃ M : FinSubext F K, ∃ hLM : L.1 ≤ M.1,
+      LinearMap.rTensor B (IntermediateField.inclusion hLM).toLinearMap x =

     9	/-!
    10	# Finite-stage covers for etale Picard representatives
    11	
    12	Every element of `PicEtAff C K` has a representative whose etale cover is the base change of
    13	a cover over a finite subextension of an algebraic extension `K/k`.
    14	
    15	This result descends only the **cover carrying the representative**.  Its descent class remains
    16	a class over `K`; no finite-stage descent of that class is asserted here.
    17	-/

    19	set_option autoImplicit false

    21	universe u
    22	
    23	open CategoryTheory
    24	
    25	open scoped TensorProduct
    26	
    27	namespace AlgebraicGeometry

    29	noncomputable section
    30	
    31	/-- A class in the etale plus construction over an algebraic field extension can be represented
    32	on the base change of an etale cover from a finite subextension.  The representative's descent
    33	class is still defined over the full field `K`. -/
    34	theorem exists_finSubext_baseChanged_cover_representation
    35	    {k K : Type u} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k K]
    36	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) (x : PicEtAff C K) :
    37	    ∃ (L : DatG0.FinSubext k K) (E₀ : Algebra.EtaleCover L.1)
    38	      (ξK : descentClasses C (E₀.baseChange K)),
    39	      PicEtAff.mk C (E₀.baseChange K) ξK = x := by

    41	  | _ E ξ =>
    42	      obtain ⟨L, B₀, hRing, hAlg, hEtale, hsurj, ⟨e⟩⟩ :=
    43	        DatG0.exists_finSubext_etaleCover_model (k := k) (K := K) E
    44	      letI : CommRing B₀ := hRing
    45	      letI : Algebra L.1 B₀ := hAlg
    46	      letI : Algebra.Etale L.1 B₀ := hEtale
    47	      let E₀ : Algebra.EtaleCover L.1 := Algebra.EtaleCover.of B₀ hsurj
    48	      let e₀ : E₀.Carrier ≃ₐ[L.1] B₀ := Algebra.EtaleCover.ofEquiv B₀ hsurj
    49	      let bcEquiv : (E₀.baseChange K).Carrier ≃ₐ[K] K ⊗[L.1] B₀ :=

    51	          (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr (AlgEquiv.refl : K ≃ₐ[K] K) e₀)
